import os, sys
print("CWD:", os.getcwd())
print(os.listdir('.'))
try:
    import pandas as pd
    print("pandas version:", pd.__version__)
    files = [f for f in os.listdir('.') if f.endswith('.xlsx') or f.endswith('.csv')]
    print("data files:", files)
except Exception as e:
    print("pandas error:", e)

import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('sales_data.xlsx', data_only=False)
print('Sheets:', wb.sheetnames)
for name in wb.sheetnames:
    ws = wb[name]
    print(f'--- {name} dims={ws.dimensions} max_row={ws.max_row} max_col={ws.max_column}')
    for i, row in enumerate(ws.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=min(6, ws.max_row), values_only=True), 1):
        print(i, row)

import zipfile

z = zipfile.ZipFile('sales_data.xlsx')
xml = z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode('utf-8')
print(xml)

import zipfile

z = zipfile.ZipFile('sales_data.xlsx')
print(z.namelist())
if 'xl/styles.xml' in z.namelist():
    print(z.read('xl/styles.xml').decode('utf-8'))

import zipfile
import shutil
import os

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
TMP = 'sales_data_new.xlsx'

zin = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC, 'r')
sheet = zin.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode('utf-8')
styles = zin.read('xl/styles.xml').decode('utf-8')

# --- sheet1.xml edits ---
# dimension
old_dim = '<dimension ref="A1:G10"/>'
new_dim = '<dimension ref="A1:H10"/>'
assert sheet.count(old_dim) == 1
sheet = sheet.replace(old_dim, new_dim)

# column width for H
old_cols = '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/></cols>'
new_cols = '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/><col width="12" customWidth="1" min="8" max="8"/></cols>'
assert sheet.count(old_cols) == 1
sheet = sheet.replace(old_cols, new_cols)

# header H1
old_h1 = '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c></row>'
new_h1 = old_h1 + '<c r="H1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit Margin (%)</t></is></c></row>'
assert sheet.count(old_h1) == 1
sheet = sheet.replace(old_h1, new_h1)

# data rows 2-9: Hn = IFERROR(Gn/En,0)
for n in range(2, 10):
    old_cell = f'<c r="G{n}"><f>E{n}-C{n}*F{n}</f><v></v></c></row>'
    new_cell = old_cell + f'<c r="H{n}"><f>IFERROR(G{n}/E{n},0)</f><v></v></c></row>'
    assert sheet.count(old_cell) == 1, f'row {n} pattern missing'
    sheet = sheet.replace(old_cell, new_cell)

# total row 10
old_t = '<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v></v></c></row>'
new_t = old_t + '<c r="H10"><f>IFERROR(G10/E10,0)</f><v></v></c></row>'
assert sheet.count(old_t) == 1
sheet = sheet.replace(old_t, new_t)

# --- styles.xml edits ---
old_nf = '<numFmts count="0"/>'
new_nf = '<numFmts count="1"><numFmt numFmtId="164" formatCode="0.0%"/></numFmts>'
assert styles.count(old_nf) == 1
styles = styles.replace(old_nf, new_nf)

old_xfs = '<cellXfs count="3">'
new_xfs = '<cellXfs count="4">'
assert styles.count(old_xfs) == 1
styles = styles.replace(old_xfs, new_xfs)
old_xf_end = '<xf numFmtId="0" fontId="1" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/></cellXfs>'
new_xf_end = '<xf numFmtId="0" fontId="1" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/><xf numFmtId="164" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/></cellXfs>'
assert styles.count(old_xf_end) == 1
styles = styles.replace(old_xf_end, new_xf_end)

# apply s="3" (percent format) to H2:H10
for n in range(2, 11):
    old_c = f'<c r="H{n}">'
    new_c = f'<c r="H{n}" s="3">'
    assert sheet.count(old_c) == 1, f'H{n} missing'
    sheet = sheet.replace(old_c, new_c)

# --- rewrite zip preserving all entries ---
zout = zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)
for item in zin.infolist():
    data = zin.read(item.filename)
    if item.filename == 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml':
        data = sheet.encode('utf-8')
    elif item.filename == 'xl/styles.xml':
        data = styles.encode('utf-8')
    zout.writestr(item, data)
zout.close()
zin.close()
shutil.move(TMP, SRC)
print('done')
